guide.title: How to connect your device
guide.step1: Get the device certificate bundle and the Amazon root CA from the Credentials tab.
guide.step2: Connect to the broker endpoint below via MQTT over TLS, with the thing name as client id.
guide.step3: Load this configuration onto the device: download the JSON or push it over a direct connection.
guide.step4: Run the procedures of each experiment in order.
guide.step5: Publish each measurement to the experiment's topic prefix plus /{{sensorVersion}}/{{sensorId}}.
guide.step6: Attach the prefilled answers to every published measurement.
guide.docsLink: Read the full device integration guide
